received.subject: Your Sri Lanka trip request is live
received.text:
Your request for {route} ({dates}) has gone to approved drivers across Sri Lanka.

What happens next:
1. Drivers send you offers, often within the first hour.
2. We email you the first one straight away, then a summary.
3. Chat with any driver, compare, and book the one you like.

View your request: {url}

prefs.allHint: One email each time a driver sends you an offer.
prefs.summary: A summary, at most once a day (recommended)
prefs.summaryHint: Your first offer straight away, then our top picks in one email.
prefs.essential: Only messages from my drivers, and my bookings

prefs.always: Whatever you choose, you will always get messages from drivers you are talking to and emails about your bookings.

answer.title: What's holding you back?
answer.intro: Your answer helps us send you something useful instead of another reminder.
answer.priceBody: Drivers set their own prices, and they often have room to adjust: fewer kilometres, a different vehicle, or a shorter route can bring the total down. Message a driver with your budget and ask what they can do.
answer.datesUntil: We will not send reminders about this request until {date}. Your request and its offers stay in your dashboard.
answer.datesForNow: We will not send reminders about this request for now. Your request and its offers stay in your dashboard.
answer.choiceBody: Reply to any of our emails about this request, or WhatsApp us on +94 76 3021 483, and our team in Sri Lanka will go through the offers with you.
answer.bookedBody: Drivers will stop sending offers for it and you will not get any more reminders. Have a great trip.

repost.alreadyBody: This request has already been sent to drivers again. New offers will arrive by email and in your dashboard.
repost.title: Post this request again?
repost.body: We will send the same request to drivers again so you get up-to-date prices. To change anything first, post a new request from your dashboard instead.
repost.liveBody: Drivers are being notified now. We will email you the first offer straight away, then a summary of the rest.
repost.problemAlready: This request has already been sent to drivers again.
repost.problemPast: The start date of this request has passed, so it cannot be posted again as it is. Post a new request with your new dates from your dashboard.
repost.problemNotOpen: This request already has a booking, so it was not posted again.
